name: android-foundation
description: Android Foundation — the centerpiece Android (Kotlin + Gradle) stack provider. Registers the android profile via manifest.yaml (kind: foundation, aspect: android, priority 300). Ships NO agents (ADR-0021): the roster lives in the sdlc core, and this plugin declares role_expertise for all 11 core roles plus 13 skills — requirements, review, MASVS security, testing, E2E, docs/vault, debugging, build-release, CI, and the Compose/architecture/data/Navigation conventions. Retrofit/Room/Hilt attach as framework plugins. Checks: detekt + unit tests + compile-check.
